actions.action: Water the pilea a day or two before separating
Gently loosen the root ball and separate the pilea by hand
Pot the pilea at the same depth in a pot with drainage and fresh well-draining mix, firming the soil lightly
Place the pilea in bright, indirect light out of direct sun while it recovers
Check that the top inch of soil is dry before watering
Check whether the pumpkin planter has a drainage hole
If there is no drainage hole, keep the plants in nursery pots set inside the pumpkin

reason: The answer calls everything healthy and gives repotting tips, but never identifies the actual fix: rearranging the plants so the Kalanchoe gets the most light. Its advice isn't damaging, though the reassurance glosses over the Kalanchoe's light needs.
